cards.lore: The Father of the Scientific Method. He moved science from Philosophical-Guessing to Empirical-Testing.
cards.power: (The Skeptic's Lens): Demands every Theory-Wrestler prove themselves through repeatable experiments, not elegant words.

cards.lore: Champions the Troupe tradition. If the book says one thing and the body shows another, trust the body.
cards.power: (The Jugna-Ganasher): Physically shows that the Old-Scrolls are wrong by looking at the Real-Wrestler-Body.

cards.lore: The cost of being right too early. Evidence is often rejected by the Consensus-Board if it challenges professional status.
cards.power: (The Fragile-Signal): Identifies the Invisible-Enemy before the arena is ready to believe it, suffering professional exile.

cards.lore: Changed the Cosmic Biology to the Invader-Logic. Turned Miasma-Mystery into Pathogen-Logic.
cards.power: (The Micro-Defense): Proves that Invisible-Invaders cause the Arena-Collapse, providing the first systematic Shilds.

cards.lore: Science doesn't Prove truths, it Disproves falsehood. A theory stays in the ring only until falsified.
cards.power: (The Black Swan-Strikes): Declares a Theory-Wrestler is only scientific if there is a more that can kill it.

cards.lore: Normal science works within a box until Anomalies pile up, leading to a Scientific-Riot (a.k.a. Paradigm Shift).
cards.power: (The Arena-Reset): Shows science moves in sudden Paradigm-Collapses where old rules are deleted.

cards.lore: Entities should not be multiplied without necessity.
cards.power: (The Efficiency-Cut): Slices through complex, bloated Conspiracy-Theories to reveal the simplest path fitting the Star-Data.

cards.lore: The corruption of the Scientific Method when Science becomes Dogma. Forgetting to Ask Questions. Forgetting is the Process of Questioning.
cards.power: (The Dogma-Trap): Wears the mask of Science but behaves like a Religion.

cards.lore: Randomization and Blinding. The only way to defeat Placebo-the-Trickster.
cards.power: (The Max-Shield): Exposes the Chemical-Ally wins because it's actually strong, not because the coach believed it.

cards.lore: Probability of observing results if the Null is true. Corrupt. Easily tricked by P-Hacking-the-Cheat.
cards.power: (The Fluke-Filter): Tells you if the Match-Outcome was a Real-Skill Win or a Random-Dice-Roll.

cards.lore: The conservative heart of science. You don't win until you KO-the-Ghost.
cards.power: (The Status-Bar-Guard): Assumes the new Drug-Wrestler is useless until proven otherwise with Overwhelming Evidence.

cards.lore: Pooling data to increase power. Identifies the True-Signal buried in the Noise of smaller matches.
cards.power: (The Arena-Synthesis): Gathers All different Match-Tapes and combines them into one Giant Verdict.

cards.lore: Research follows the money. Creates Incentive-Glitches treating only profitable symptoms.
cards.power: (The Funding-Friction): Decides which Wrestlers get into the arena based on Profit-Potential rather than Cure-Potential.

cards.lore: Running 100 tests until one looks Significant by chance. Turns Noise into False-Verdicts.
cards.power: (The Statistic-Torture): Tortures the Data-Wrestler until it Confesses to a significant result, even if there isn't one.

cards.lore: The Filter of Success. It skews Meta-Analysis because the Evidence-Pile is missing all failures.
cards.power: (The File-Drawer Trap): Hides every Losing-Match-Tape in a basement creating the Illusion of 100% win ratio.

cards.lore: Financial ties compromise objectivity. Interpreting Tie-Matches as sponsor victories.
cards.power: (The Hidden Influence): Whispers to the Principal Investigator, Interpreting a Tie-Match as a Victory for the Sponsor.

cards.lore: Machine learning in drug discovery. Finds patterns the human brain could never see.
cards.power: (The In-Silico-Sprint): Runs a billion Virtual-Matches in a second to find the perfect Protein-Amino-Shape before a real lab opens.

cards.lore: Moving from Population-Average to Individual-Reality. The Standard-Mean is replaced by the Personal-Match.
cards.power: (The Individual-Verdict): Tailors the Chemical-Ally to fit your specific DNA-Lock.

cards.lore: Rapid dissemination vs Rigor. Great for Pandemic-Panic, but prone to Error-Glitches.
cards.power: (The Information-Burst): Bypasses the Peer-Review-Pandemonium to deliver Match-Results instantly.

cards.lore: The movement for Democratic-Data. If the public paid for the match, they should see the tape for free.
cards.power: (The Paywall-Breaker): Smashes the Journal-Fortress gates so every Roster-Doctor can see the Research-Bundle.

cards.lore: Tells you where the True-Value is. The narrower the bracket, the more precise the move.
cards.power: (The Uncertainty-Bracket): Shows the True-Value must-Almost-Ever if the arena is too wide, the Verdict is a shaky guess.

cards.lore: Correlation vs Causation. If R-Square is low, the connection is Noise and the Theory is weak.
cards.power: (The Connection-Strength): Tells you how much of the Outcome is actually explained by the Variable-Move.

cards.lore: Translates Complex-Research-Math into Bedside-Reality. An NNT of 1000 is a weak move.
cards.power: (The Reality-Check): Tells you how many Wrestlers you must treat to save one from a Lethal-Outcome.

cards.lore: Used in Oncology. Compares Event-Rate between two groups throughout the whole match.
cards.power: (The Speed-of-Death): Tells you if the Chemical-Ally slows down the Clock-of-Disease compared to the Placebo-Ghost.

cards.lore: Outcome back to Exposure. Best for Rare-Zebra hunts where you can't wait for a new study.
cards.power: (The History-Appeals): Finds wrestlers who already lost, looking back to see if they touched the same Toxic-Shield.

cards.lore: Exposure forward to Outcome. The Gold Standard of observational matches.
cards.power: (The Long-Match): Takes a group of Exposure-Wrestlers and follows them for 20 years to see who Crashes first.

cards.lore: The ultimate defense against Placebo-the-Trickster and Investigator-Effect Bias.
cards.power: (The Bias-Eraser): Ensures Expectation-Sparks don't pollute the Data-Stream. Both Wrestler and Ref are in the dark on what quantity.

cards.lore: The power of belief. Science must prove its Move is stronger than the Trickster's mojo.
cards.power: (The Mind-Healer): Heals the Wrestler just by making them believe they get a better Chemical-Ally in a Clinical trial.

cards.lore: The response to Historical-Horrors. Research must serve the subject, not just the Data Gods.
cards.power: (The Human-Shield): Ensures Wrestlers are not treated like Laboratory-Rats and the match is worth the risk.

cards.lore: The legal and ethical Shield of Autonomy. Science cannot happen in secret.
cards.power: (The Sovereign-Voice): Ensures the Wrestler knows exactly what Monsters are in the arena before entering the ring.

cards.lore: Big cop oversight. Prevents Mad-Scientist-Heel-Turns by demanding ethical accountability.
cards.power: (The Protocol-Police): Reads the Match-Plan before it starts and Blocks any match that is Legally Shaky.

cards.lore: The ethical Constitution of the World Medical Association.
cards.power: (The Universal-Rulebook): Sets the Global Standard for how Human-Wrestlers must be treated in every arena on Earth.

cards.lore: The shift from Sampling to Total-Observation. Powerful, but prone to Noise-Glitches.
cards.power: (The Infinite-Library): Looks at millions of Electronic-Health-Scrolls to find Hidden-Patterns a tiny-RCT would miss.

cards.lore: Correlation is not Causation. The nemesis of Logic-the-Razor.
cards.power: (The Illusion-Mist): Makes it look like Move-A caused Outcome-B, but really it was Variable-C hiding in the shadows.

cards.lore: Transparency. Prevents Outcome-Switching and Marking.
cards.power: (The Public-Vow): Makes the Coach announce the Match-Rules before the fight, preventing them from changing the Winning-Criteria later.

cards.lore: A single win is a fluke; a repeatable win is a fact.
cards.power: (The Reality-Check): Demands the Miracle-Victory be performed again in a Different-Arena. If it can't be repeated, it's not a fact.

cards.lore: The Initial-Testing-Ground. Cells in a dish don't behave like cells in a human.
cards.power: (The Isolated-Brawl): Allows the Chemical-Ally to fight the Pathogen-Punk in glass without the Wrestler-Body interfering.

cards.lore: The Translational bridge from Dish to Human, though Mice are not small men.
cards.power: (The Proxy-Wrestler): Takes the Chemical-Hits first to see if the Arena-Stats are safe for humans.

cards.lore: Molecular biology. The Hardware-Audit of the cell.
cards.power: (The Protein-Scanner): Identifies exactly which Protein-Armor-Pieces are being built by the cell in what quantity.

cards.lore: Functional genomics. If the wrestler Crashes, we know the gene's Power-Level.
cards.power: (The Source-Code-Kill): Deletes a single Manual-Page (Gene) to see if the Wrestler can survive without it.

cards.lore: Competition for resources. Only the most Resourceful-Grantee makes it. Without him, science stops.
cards.power: (The Lifeline): Provides the Tokens needed to pay the Arena-Fees and bring the Wrestlers to the ring.

cards.lore: The economic engine of drug discovery. Balances Innovation-Incentive vs Access-Cost.
cards.power: (The Exclusive-Contract): Ensures only one Coach can call the Chemical-Ally, charging high Fees for Restricted-Access.

cards.lore: Quality-Control. The most feared Gremlin in the Academia-Arena.
cards.power: (The Critical-Block): Finds every tiny Glitch in the Match-Tape and demands a Rematch (Revision) before the world sees it.

cards.lore: The Currency-of-Prestige. Leads to Bias for High-Rank Journals. Tracks really high-scoring matches only.
cards.power: (The Prestige-Rank): Decides how much weight the Match-Result carries. The Lancet, Nature, Science, NEJM.

cards.lore: The organized skepticism in the reliability of expert opinion.
cards.power: (The Dogma-Defense): Refuses to believe the Consensus-Wrestler until the Raw-Data-Scrolls are shown.

cards.lore: The most common Thinking-Trap. Tag team partners aren't necessarily the boss of each other.
cards.power: (The False-Connection): Shows two things moving together, but warns that one did NOT cause the other.

cards.lore: A Better-Number doesn't always mean a Better-Patient.
cards.power: (The Number-Game): Focuses on changing a Stat instead of the Real-Outcome (Death). You win the Stat-Match but lose the Life-Match.

cards.lore: A strong verdict should survive many different Arena-Conditions.
cards.power: (The Stress-Tester): Changes the Match-Rules slightly to see if the Verdict still stands. If it breaks, the research was Fragile.

cards.lore: The democratization of discovery. Patient-Led-Research.
cards.power: (The People's Arena): Bypasses the Academic-Monopoly, allowing thousands of Non-Wrestlers to contribute data.

cards.lore: Identifies Side-Effect-Saboteurs that only appear once millions are treated.
cards.power: (The Wild-Arena-Test): Looks at how the Chemical-Ally performs in the messy real world with Multi-Morb-Mix wrestlers.

cards.lore: The cure for P-Hacker-the-Cheat. If you show the work, the Cheat can't hide.
cards.power: (The Truth-Revealer): Demands the Raw-Match-Tapes be available for anyone to Fact-Check.

cards.lore: The challenge of Autonomous Biology. We must ensure the Pattern-Finder is responsible.
cards.power: (The Moral-Brake): Ensures the Human-Wrestler still has the Final-Say and isn't just a Data-Point for the AI.

cards.lore: Science is searching for the truth, not Safety. Stay Fluffy!
cards.power: (The Rigor Enforcer): Trust the method, not the person. Double the consensus until the data is raw.

cards.lore: Big Pharma funds a drug. Results look Significant, but the NNT is 5000. QUEST: Summon Scientism-the-False-God and deploy Replication-Match to demand strict P-Test.
A massive Signal challenges the consensus. The Peer-Review refuses certification. QUEST: Deploy Open-the-Access-Knight and get the data to the arena!

AI finds a hidden Genetic-Glitch causing Heart-Collapse in low Cardiology-Patients. QUEST: Combine AI-the-Pattern-Predictor + Precision-the-Genetic-Sniper, while ensuring Ethical-the-AI-Limit protects Wrestler-ethics.
